answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities. Each new identity pays a sunk tax of 10 days' earnings before working, so capital cannot be recycled across clones. A whisper of talk cannot bypass it: each applicant pays the tax and waits one epoch for checks. Honest agents tend one orchard, while taxes flow into a lagoon reserve funding audits. Making 100 fakes costs 1,000 days, with no return; one honest identity pays 10 days once and keeps undiluted rewards.
